source_requirement_summary: Maintain authoritative records and lifecycle history
preconditions_draft: Authorized tester; approved tenant; valid test record and lifecycle rules available.
steps_draft: 1. Create or select a valid in-scope record. 2. Perform the permitted lifecycle transition. 3. Retrieve the record and its history. 4. Verify tenant and record identity.
expected_result_draft: Applicable actor can access the authoritative record; permitted transition is reflected consistently in the record and lifecycle history; traceability to the parent BRD is retained.
negative_path_draft: Attempt an invalid transition or cross-tenant read only if explicitly covered by approved criteria; expect rejection/denial without unauthorized state change.
evidence_to_capture: Record ID, before/after state, lifecycle history/audit reference, authorized tenant context.
notes: Draft derived from generic BRD/SRS pattern only. Validate chapter-specific actors, business rules, data, and expected outcomes against the detailed BRD and approved baseline before execution.
proposed_measurable_oracle_draft: For an approved actor, tenant, record and allowed transition: assert the operation outcome matches the approved contract; persisted state equals the approved target state; retrieved record identity and tenant are unchanged; and lifecycle history contains the expected transition with a traceable event/reference. For a rejected transition, assert state and history remain unchanged.
oracle_owner_decisions_required: Approve actor/tenant/test record; exact allowed and forbidden transitions; target states; expected response/status; required history fields; consistency/visibility timing; any permitted duplicate-event behavior.

source_requirement_summary: Enforce role-based authorization before material actions
preconditions_draft: Approved role-to-action matrix; at least one authorized and one unauthorized test identity; approved tenant scope.
steps_draft: 1. Sign in as an authorized role. 2. Perform the permitted material action. 3. Sign in as a role without that permission. 4. Attempt the same action and verify the result.
expected_result_draft: Authorized action is permitted only within approved role and tenant scope; unauthorized action is denied and does not mutate protected data.
negative_path_draft: Attempt the action with insufficient privilege and, where approved, against another tenant; expect denial and no data leakage or state change.
evidence_to_capture: Role/permission reference, session authorization reference (no tokens), action outcome, audit/security event.
notes: Draft derived from generic BRD/SRS pattern only. Validate chapter-specific actors, business rules, data, and expected outcomes against the detailed BRD and approved baseline before execution.
proposed_measurable_oracle_draft: Run the same protected action with one approved authorized identity and one identity explicitly lacking the permission. Assert the authorized action succeeds only within its approved scope; the unauthorized action is denied according to the approved response policy; protected data is not mutated by the denied attempt; and no out-of-scope record is disclosed.
oracle_owner_decisions_required: Approve role-to-action-resource matrix; tenant boundary cases; expected denial status/error shape; whether denial is logged and required audit fields; test identities and safe test data.

source_requirement_summary: Validate mandatory business conditions before material changes
preconditions_draft: Approved business rules, mandatory fields, preconditions, and valid/invalid test data are identified.
steps_draft: 1. Submit a valid transaction satisfying all approved conditions. 2. Verify the resulting state. 3. Submit a transaction omitting or violating one approved mandatory condition. 4. Inspect response and state.
expected_result_draft: Valid processing produces the specified outcome; invalid processing is rejected or handled as the approved constraint specifies; no partial or inconsistent material change remains.
negative_path_draft: Omit a mandatory field or violate one approved precondition; expect the documented validation response and no unintended material change.
evidence_to_capture: Approved rule/test-data reference, request/correlation ID, validation response, before/after state.
notes: Draft derived from generic BRD/SRS pattern only. Validate chapter-specific actors, business rules, data, and expected outcomes against the detailed BRD and approved baseline before execution.
proposed_measurable_oracle_draft: For each approved validation rule, execute one valid boundary/control input and one invalid input. Assert the valid case is accepted and persisted according to the contract; the invalid case returns the approved validation identifier/message and field reference; and no partial or unintended state change is present after rejection.
oracle_owner_decisions_required: Approve rule inventory; valid/invalid boundary values; required/optional fields; error identifiers/messages; transaction atomicity expectations; whether multiple validation errors are aggregated or returned one at a time.

source_requirement_summary: Preserve audit evidence for material events
preconditions_draft: Audit policy and event fields approved; tester can access authorized audit view/export.
steps_draft: 1. Perform an approved material action. 2. Locate the corresponding audit event. 3. Verify actor, timestamp, target, action, outcome, and correlation/linkage fields required by policy. 4. Verify authorized audit retrieval.
expected_result_draft: Required audit evidence is attributable, retrievable, linked to the material event, and consistent with the observed action and result.
negative_path_draft: Attempt audit access without permission if in approved scope; expect denial. Do not alter or delete audit evidence.
evidence_to_capture: Event ID, timestamp, actor reference, target/action/outcome, audit query/export reference.
notes: Draft derived from generic BRD/SRS pattern only. Validate chapter-specific actors, business rules, data, and expected outcomes against the detailed BRD and approved baseline before execution.
proposed_measurable_oracle_draft: Trigger one approved material action and correlate it to the audit record using the approved correlation/business reference. Assert the event is retrievable within the approved visibility window, required fields and actor/tenant/target/action/outcome values match the action, integrity controls are satisfied, and retention/retrieval behavior meets the approved policy.
oracle_owner_decisions_required: Approve material-event catalogue; required/immutable fields; correlation mechanism; event cardinality/duplicate handling; visibility SLA; integrity verification; retention period and retrieval permissions.

source_requirement_summary: Support controlled exception handling
preconditions_draft: Approved exception taxonomy, retry/recovery rules, and safe test scenario available.
steps_draft: 1. Trigger a specifically approved failure/exception condition. 2. Verify structured error and correlation/exception ID. 3. Follow the approved recovery or disposition path. 4. Verify final state and audit linkage.
expected_result_draft: Exception is handled by the approved policy, is attributable and traceable, and does not leave an unapproved partial or duplicate state; recovery matches the defined rule.
negative_path_draft: Repeat/replay or retry only where approved; verify duplicate prevention, bounded retry, or compensation according to the documented rule.
evidence_to_capture: Exception/defect ID, correlation ID, error details, recovery/disposition record, resulting state.
notes: Draft derived from generic BRD/SRS pattern only. Validate chapter-specific actors, business rules, data, and expected outcomes against the detailed BRD and approved baseline before execution.
proposed_measurable_oracle_draft: Trigger the approved failure condition and follow the approved retry/recovery procedure. Assert attempt count and timing stay within policy; repeated delivery does not create duplicate business effects where idempotency is required; final state matches the approved recovery/terminal-state rule; and failed recovery produces the defined escalation/dead-letter/compensation evidence.
oracle_owner_decisions_required: Approve failure injection method; retry count/backoff; idempotency key and duplicate-effect definition; compensation rules; terminal states; escalation/dead-letter behavior and timing; recovery owner and evidence.

expected_result_draft: Report is available to the authorized actor, respects filters and tenant/role boundaries, and matches approved source/reconciliation and freshness rules.
negative_path_draft: Attempt access as an unauthorized role or across an unauthorized tenant where approved; expect denial or appropriately scoped results.
evidence_to_capture: Report/export reference, filter parameters, source record IDs, reconciliation result, timestamp.
notes: Draft derived from generic BRD/SRS pattern only. Validate chapter-specific actors, business rules, data, and expected outcomes against the detailed BRD and approved baseline before execution.

steps_draft: 1. Perform an approved material action. 2. Locate the corresponding audit event. 3. Verify actor, timestamp, target, action, outcome, and correlation/linkage fields required by policy. 4. Verify authorized audit retrieval.
expected_result_draft: Required audit evidence is attributable, retrievable, linked to the material event, and consistent with the observed action and result.
negative_path_draft: Attempt audit access without permission if in approved scope; expect denial. Do not alter or delete audit evidence.
evidence_to_capture: Event ID, timestamp, actor reference, target/action/outcome, audit query/export reference.
notes: Draft derived from generic BRD/SRS pattern only. Validate chapter-specific actors, business rules, data, and expected outcomes against the detailed BRD and approved baseline before execution.
proposed_measurable_oracle_draft: Trigger one approved material action and correlate it to the audit record using the approved correlation/business reference. Assert the event is retrievable within the approved visibility window, required fields and actor/tenant/target/action/outcome values match the action, integrity controls are satisfied, and retention/retrieval behavior meets the approved policy.
oracle_owner_decisions_required: Approve material-event catalogue; required/immutable fields; correlation mechanism; event cardinality/duplicate handling; visibility SLA; integrity verification; retention period and retrieval permissions.

source_requirement_summary: Support controlled exception handling
preconditions_draft: Approved exception taxonomy, retry/recovery rules, and safe test scenario available.
steps_draft: 1. Trigger a specifically approved failure/exception condition. 2. Verify structured error and correlation/exception ID. 3. Follow the approved recovery or disposition path. 4. Verify final state and audit linkage.
expected_result_draft: Exception is handled by the approved policy, is attributable and traceable, and does not leave an unapproved partial or duplicate state; recovery matches the defined rule.
negative_path_draft: Repeat/replay or retry only where approved; verify duplicate prevention, bounded retry, or compensation according to the documented rule.
evidence_to_capture: Exception/defect ID, correlation ID, error details, recovery/disposition record, resulting state.
notes: Draft derived from generic BRD/SRS pattern only. Validate chapter-specific actors, business rules, data, and expected outcomes against the detailed BRD and approved baseline before execution.
proposed_measurable_oracle_draft: Trigger the approved failure condition and follow the approved retry/recovery procedure. Assert attempt count and timing stay within policy; repeated delivery does not create duplicate business effects where idempotency is required; final state matches the approved recovery/terminal-state rule; and failed recovery produces the defined escalation/dead-letter/compensation evidence.
oracle_owner_decisions_required: Approve failure injection method; retry count/backoff; idempotency key and duplicate-effect definition; compensation rules; terminal states; escalation/dead-letter behavior and timing; recovery owner and evidence.

source_requirement_summary: Provide governed reporting for status, exceptions and performance
preconditions_draft: Approved report definition, authorized role/tenant, known source records, freshness expectations, and reconciliation rule.
steps_draft: 1. Open the approved report as an authorized user. 2. Apply agreed filters. 3. Compare totals/statuses with known source records. 4. Verify freshness and access boundaries.
expected_result_draft: Report is available to the authorized actor, respects filters and tenant/role boundaries, and matches approved source/reconciliation and freshness rules.
negative_path_draft: Attempt access as an unauthorized role or across an unauthorized tenant where approved; expect denial or appropriately scoped results.
evidence_to_capture: Report/export reference, filter parameters, source record IDs, reconciliation result, timestamp.
notes: Draft derived from generic BRD/SRS pattern only. Validate chapter-specific actors, business rules, data, and expected outcomes against the detailed BRD and approved baseline before execution.
proposed_measurable_oracle_draft: Run the approved report with a fixed, independently reconciled test dataset and approved filters. Assert each returned row and aggregate equals the independently calculated expected result; filters and role/tenant boundaries exclude out-of-scope data; and data freshness, export fields and lineage references satisfy the approved reporting contract.
oracle_owner_decisions_required: Approve report/metric definitions; fixed expected dataset and independent calculation; rounding/null/time-zone rules; filter semantics; freshness SLA; row/aggregate reconciliation tolerance (if any); export schema and access policy.
